name: Gábor Kovács
bio:
Gábor's motorsport journey began with a fascination for rally racing, fueled by watching the Hungarian Championship events near his hometown. Despite lacking the financial means to pursue a career as a driver, he channeled his passion into understanding the technical aspects of racing. He earned a degree in mechanical engineering and quickly found his niche coordinating test sessions for smaller racing teams. 

Gábor is methodical and detail-oriented, thriving on the challenge of optimizing testing schedules and ensuring accurate data collection. His ambition is to elevate his coordination skills to a top-tier Formula team, meticulously managing every aspect of the test program. While he's known for working independently and sometimes prefers solitary work, he recognizes the importance of collaboration and is open to new methodologies.

What sets Gábor apart is his uncanny ability to foresee potential mechanical issues during testing based on subtle changes in data. This intuition, coupled with his engineering background, makes him a valuable asset in any team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: Gábor is of average height with a lean build and intense, focused eyes.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes and diagrams.
Has a peculiar habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Insists on cleaning his workspace meticulously before and after each test session.
